title: Conan requirement pinned to a user channel
description: conanfile.txt declares a `name/version@user/channel` reference. A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `name/version@user/channel` reference.
remediation: Point the declaration or the registry configuration at the namespace the project controls, and remove the lookup path that resolves elsewhere. Specifically: fix a `name/version@user/channel` reference.
limitation: It matches a `name/version@user/channel` reference in the parsed conanfile.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
